   106		action := autoUpdateActionUpdate

   109				displayVersion(currentVersion), displayVersion(latestVersion))).
   110			Description("Release notes: "+releaseNotesURL(latestVersion)).
   111			Options(

   113				huh.NewOption("Skip", autoUpdateActionSkip),
   114				huh.NewOption("Skip until next version", autoUpdateActionSkipUntilNextVersion),

   124			}

   126		}
